definition: End-to-end supplied straw length
notes: Specify folded, extended, or straight state

definition: Internal bore diameter
notes: ISO tolerance applies only to PP straws within the standard scope

definition: External tube diameter
notes: Some sources say 'diameter' without explicitly distinguishing inner/outer

definition: Radial wall thickness
notes: Paper caliper may differ from calculated tube-wall thickness

definition: Mass of one unwrapped straw
notes: Huhtamaki unit value is calculated from carton net mass and flagged provisional

definition: Principal structural material
allowed_values_or_formula: PP; paper; PLA; glass; steel; bamboo; jute; other
notes: Record coatings/additives separately when known

definition: Mass of individual wrapper per straw
notes: Baron provides film dimensions/properties but not wrapper mass

definition: Material of individual wrapper
allowed_values_or_formula: polymer film; paper+polymer; PE; OPP; none; unknown
notes: Distinguish material from mass

definition: Nominal beverage fill volume
notes: Nominal volume is not external geometric volume

definition: Reported package material surface area
notes: Tetra Pak reports 0.03 m² for the 200 mL package

definition: External pack height
notes: Do not infer from nominal volume

definition: External pack width
notes: Do not infer from nominal volume

definition: External pack depth
notes: Do not infer from nominal volume

definition: Nominal opening or straw-hole size
notes: SIG xSlimBloc page lists 6 and 8 mm options; not necessarily puncture slit diameter

definition: Position of insertion point in container coordinate system
notes: Required for analytical minimum-length geometry

definition: Description of membrane/opening and puncture geometry
notes: Tetra Pak: small foil opening; SIG: closed straw hole pierced by diagonal cut

definition: Length outside container required for acceptable drinking
notes: Must be defined and tested

definition: Unconsumed beverage after attempted normal use
notes: Primary functional constraint candidate

definition: Angle of straw during use relative to defined container axis
notes: Coordinate convention must be defined

definition: Force at axial collapse or failure
notes: Laboratory geometry and wet exposure must accompany the value

definition: Force at radial collapse or failure
notes: Not interchangeable with user biting or puncture force

definition: Whether straw ruptures after specified bend test
notes: ISO method: 90° bend/release at five points for PP straws

definition: Time immersed or exposed before mechanical test
notes: Liquid, depth, and temperature must also be recorded

definition: Initial liquid temperature
notes: Gutierrez tested water at 0, 21, 48, 82°C and cold carbonated beverage

definition: Mass increase after liquid exposure
notes: Not equivalent to liquid migration or user acceptability

definition: Expected number of additional straws used per successful serving relative to one initial straw
notes: Primary Monte Carlo rebound parameter; not a probability

definition: Independent probability that each straw attempt fails and another attempt is required
notes: Alternative geometric-attempt model used for analytical and one-way sensitivity

definition: Container or package burden caused by the geometry change per successful serving normalized to baseline straw material mass
notes: Added once per successful serving in both straw formulations

definition: Probability that a configuration is accepted and used successfully
notes: Define population and task

definition: Number of straws in supplier outer carton
notes: Huhtamaki: 2,500; Franz: 1,400; Baron: 28,000

definition: Rectangular volume from outer-carton dimensions
notes: Not palletized or effective vehicle volume

definition: Gross shipped mass of outer carton
notes: Not supplied by Baron

definition: Net product mass in outer carton
notes: Interpretation should be checked against inner packaging

definition: Outer-carton rectangular volume divided by straw count
notes: A carton-level allocation, not actual individual wrapper volume

definition: Successful beverage servings per transport volume
notes: Must account for replacement/failure and integer packing

definition: Accessory and attributable packaging mass per successful beverage serving
notes: Report components separately

definition: Sum of quantified target PFAS per straw
notes: Method- and target-list-dependent; nondetect handling must be documented

definition: Sum of quantified target PFAS per material mass
notes: Not directly comparable with ng/straw without straw mass

definition: Target or suspect PFAS detected above study criterion
notes: Detection is not intentional use, migration, exposure, or noncompliance

definition: Climate-change indicator per study functional unit
notes: Never compare across studies without reconciling functional unit and boundary

definition: Acidification indicator per study functional unit
notes: Units/methods differ across studies

definition: Water-scarcity indicator per study functional unit
notes: Tetra Pak study only among quantified evidence extracted here

definition: Provenance category
allowed_values_or_formula: observed; measured; manufacturer-provided; standards-derived; calculated; inferred; assumed; hypothetical; missing
notes: Required for every optimization input
